::: {#def-risk-ratio}
#### Risk ratio (also called the relative risk, relative risk ratio or probability ratio)

Let:

- $\risk_1$ be the [risk](#def-outcome-risk) of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in group 1.
- $\risk_2 > 0$ be the risk of the same outcome in the [reference group](#def-reference-group), group 2.

The **risk ratio**, also called the **relative risk**, **relative risk ratio** or **probability ratio**, of group 1 compared with group 2 is

$$\riskratio \eqdef \frac{\risk_1}{\risk_2} \in [0, \infty).$$

Source: @wikipedia_relative_risk.
:::
